title: Network Performance Issues in Montreal, Canada
summary: Cloudflare identified an issue that affected network performance in Montreal, Canada, between 20:10 and 20:40 UTC on November 16, 2026. During this time, customers may have experienced increased HTTP 499 errors and elevated latency. This incident has been resolved.
